visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace repeated colours with a variable
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The same colour is written in three rules. Put it in a variable and use var() in the rules. The colours must stay the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
Gold

Link
Box

solution.code:
Gold

solution.explanation: A colour used in many places is a design decision, so it should live in one place. With a variable, changing the colour is a one-line edit and all three rules stay in step.
